text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, mild anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential with monocytosis and basophilia. There is also elevated creatinine, mild hyperchloremia, and low total CO₂, suggesting possible renal impairment and metabolic acidosis. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes with possible renal involvement; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
